name: apollo-tokens
description: Apollo brand design systems (brands/<slug>/design) and the preview hub that serves them all on one port.

scripts.check:hub: node --check preview-hub/server.mjs && node --check preview-hub/smoke.mjs && node .skills/apply-apollo-theme/scripts/theme-manifest.mjs splitbook > /dev/null && node .skills/apply-apollo-theme/scripts/theme-manifest.mjs hermes > /dev/null
scripts.check: npm run check:hub && npm --prefix brands/splitbook/design run check:fast && npm --prefix brands/hermes/design run check:fast
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix brands/splitbook/design install && npm --prefix brands/hermes/design install
